flags.item: No odds at the checked NFL odds route
flags.finding: The official NFL.com /odds/ path returned the NFL 404 page on 2026-11-14. This says nothing definitive about every independent operator feed.
flags.impact: No verified opening/closing market line or price; market values, differences, ROI and CLV stay blank.

flags.item: No documented NFL-data permission for a betting/market feed
flags.finding: The current NFL.com Terms §1.3 page limits use to individual non-commercial informational purposes and bars systematic collection absent express prior written consent. No separate permission is evidenced in the repository.
flags.impact: A new quote provider alone does not authorize combining NFL.com-derived features with betting use.

flags.item: Week 10 model snapshot lacks an exact capture/cutoff timestamp
flags.finding: The saved model result has a snapshot date only. The official Week 10 schedule page displayed WAS–NYG as FINAL on the current re-read; the historical model output is therefore not treated as a live or fully pregame-verified quote.
flags.impact: Existing model numbers are reproducible historical outputs, not executable opening lines.

flags.item: No qualified strategy or live strategy exists in the project record
flags.finding: The NFL project protocol is paper research only and disables cash payments. Separately, the 30-candidate NFL results pipeline has zero qualified entries; one provisional result is not a live strategy.
flags.impact: The demotion policy is defined and tested but has not executed against an actual live strategy.

flags.item: Model-originated estimates are not independently market-calibrated fair values
flags.finding: The stored Week 10 output contains model-originated spread, total and win-probability estimates, but no corresponding authorized quote snapshot or independently verified market calibration.
flags.impact: These model-only numbers are displayed as derived estimates and are not presented as validated fair prices or an edge.
